_convention: Every scalar field (number, boolean, spring name, mode) <c> has a sibling field <c>_origin in the same object: 'file:line' (or 'file:l1-l2') in a pinned upstream source (file prefixes and pinned commits are listed in shared/data/PROVENANCE.md), a URL, or 'M3E-visual: <reason>'. Fractions (fades, masks) are measured on the spatial progress of the segment, p = clamp((u - u0)/(u_target - u0), 0, 1), where u is the normalised position of the travel driven by the pattern's Spatial spring (like MDC's getAnimatedFraction, which drives both the motion and the thresholds: MaterialContainerTransform.java:964-969), and not on a share of its duration. Units are logical px (1 dp = 1 logical px).
